import Mathlib

structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=
  u < g.size ∧
  ∃ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] ∧ pair.1 = v ∧ pair.2 = w

def WeightedGraph.well_formed (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u, u < g.size →
    -- Bounds check
    (∀ pair, pair ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → pair.1 < g.size) ∧
    -- Simple graph check (matches Dafny)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

structure MSTEdge where
  u : Nat
  v : Nat
  w : Int

-- 1. Validity
def MSTEdge.is_valid (e : MSTEdge) (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.has_edge e.u e.v e.w

-- 2. Connectivity for Solution Edges (Undirected View)
-- Dafny: `edge_in_set` checks (u, v) || (v, u)
def edges_contain (edges : List MSTEdge) (u v : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∃ e, e ∈ edges ∧ ((e.u = u ∧ e.v = v) ∨ (e.u = v ∧ e.v = u))

def path_follows_edges (edges : List MSTEdge) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    edges_contain edges (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0)

def is_connected_with_edges (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_edges edges p

-- 3. Spanning Tree Definition
def is_spanning_tree (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  edges.length = g.size - 1 ∧
  (∀ e, e ∈ edges → e.is_valid g) ∧
  is_connected_with_edges g edges
  -- Note: |V|-1 edges + Connected implies Acyclic (Tree)

def total_weight (edges : List MSTEdge) : Int :=
  edges.foldl (λ sum e => sum + e.w) 0

-- 4. Optimality (MST)
def is_mst (g : WeightedGraph) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Prop :=
  is_spanning_tree g edges ∧
  ∀ other, is_spanning_tree g other → total_weight edges ≤ total_weight other

-- 5. Graph Connectivity (Precondition)
-- Dafny uses directed edges for the graph path check: `graph_has_any_edge`
def path_follows_graph (g : WeightedGraph) (p : List Nat) : Prop :=
  p.length > 0 ∧
  ∀ i, i + 1 < p.length →
    ∃ w, g.has_edge (p.getD i 0) (p.getD (i + 1) 0) w

def WeightedGraph.is_connected (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  ∀ u v, u < g.size → v < g.size →
    ∃ p, p.head? = some u ∧ p.getLast? = some v ∧ path_follows_graph g p

def WeightedGraph.weights_bounded (g : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  g.size ≤ 100000 ∧
  ∀ u v w, g.has_edge u v w → w ≥ -100000 ∧ w ≤ 100000

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def prim_mst_precond (graph : WeightedGraph) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  graph.well_formed ∧
  graph.size > 0 ∧
  graph.is_connected ∧
  graph.weights_bounded ∧
  -- Undirected: if u→v with weight w exists, then so does v→u with the same weight
  (∀ u v w, graph.has_edge u v w → graph.has_edge v u w)

namespace Prim

/-! ### Small list helpers (stated so that we never depend on fragile simp names). -/

lemma getD_cons_zero' (a : Nat) (p : List Nat) : (a :: p).getD 0 0 = a := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma getD_cons_succ' (a : Nat) (p : List Nat) (i : Nat) :
    (a :: p).getD (i + 1) 0 = p.getD i 0 := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma getD_one' (a b : Nat) (t : List Nat) : (a :: b :: t).getD 1 0 = b := by
  first | rfl | simp

lemma getLast?_cons_cons' (x y : Nat) (t : List Nat) :
    (x :: y :: t).getLast? = (y :: t).getLast? := by
  first | rfl | simp

/-! ### Undirected reachability along a list of edges. -/

/-- One undirected step along the edge list. -/
def Step (edges : List MSTEdge) (a b : Nat) : Prop := edges_contain edges a b

/-- Reachability: the reflexive transitive closure of `Step`. -/
def Reach (edges : List MSTEdge) (a b : Nat) : Prop :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen (Step edges) a b

lemma step_symm {edges : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} (h : Step edges a b) : Step edges b a := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := h
  exact ⟨e, he, hc.symm⟩

lemma reach_symm {edges : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} (h : Reach edges a b) : Reach edges b a := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.trans (Relation.ReflTransGen.single (step_symm hbc)) ih

lemma reach_trans {edges : List MSTEdge} {a b c : Nat}
    (h1 : Reach edges a b) (h2 : Reach edges b c) : Reach edges a c :=
  Relation.ReflTransGen.trans h1 h2

lemma step_mono {e1 e2 : List MSTEdge} (h : ∀ x ∈ e1, x ∈ e2) {a b : Nat}
    (hs : Step e1 a b) : Step e2 a b := by
  obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := hs
  exact ⟨e, h e he, hc⟩

lemma reach_mono {e1 e2 : List MSTEdge} (h : ∀ x ∈ e1, x ∈ e2) {a b : Nat}
    (hr : Reach e1 a b) : Reach e2 a b := by
  induction hr with
  | refl => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih => exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail ih (step_mono h hbc)

/-! ### Paths versus reachability. -/

lemma path_singleton (edges : List MSTEdge) (a : Nat) : path_follows_edges edges [a] := by
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hi
  exact absurd hi (by omega)

lemma path_cons {edges : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} {p : List Nat}
    (hp : path_follows_edges edges p) (hh : p.head? = some b)
    (hab : edges_contain edges a b) : path_follows_edges edges (a :: p) := by
  obtain ⟨_, hstep⟩ := hp
  refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  cases i with
  | zero =>
      have hb : p.getD 0 0 = b := by
        cases p with
        | nil => simp at hh
        | cons x t =>
            have : x = b := by simpa using hh
            simpa [getD_cons_zero'] using this
      simpa [getD_cons_zero', getD_cons_succ', hb] using hab
  | succ j =>
      have hj : j + 1 < p.length := by
        simp only [List.length_cons] at hi
        omega
      have h2 := hstep j hj
      simpa [getD_cons_succ'] using h2

lemma path_tail {edges : List MSTEdge} {z : Nat} {p : List Nat}
    (h : path_follows_edges edges (z :: p)) (hp : 0 < p.length) :
    path_follows_edges edges p := by
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have h2 := h.2 (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
  simpa [getD_cons_succ'] using h2

lemma getLast?_cons_of_head {p : List Nat} {b c : Nat} (hh : p.head? = some b) :
    (c :: p).getLast? = p.getLast? := by
  cases p with
  | nil => simp at hh
  | cons x t => exact getLast?_cons_cons' c x t

/-- Reachability yields a concrete path (built by prepending, hence stated reversed). -/
lemma reach_to_rpath {edges : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} (h : Reach edges a b) :
    ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some b ∧ p.getLast? = some a ∧ path_follows_edges edges p := by
  induction h with
  | refl =>
      exact ⟨[a], by first | rfl | simp, by first | rfl | simp, path_singleton edges a⟩
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
      obtain ⟨p, hh, hl, hp⟩ := ih
      refine ⟨c :: p, by first | rfl | simp, ?_, path_cons hp hh (step_symm hbc)⟩
      rw [getLast?_cons_of_head hh]
      exact hl

lemma reach_to_path {edges : List MSTEdge} {a b : Nat} (h : Reach edges a b) :
    ∃ p : List Nat, p.head? = some a ∧ p.getLast? = some b ∧ path_follows_edges edges p :=
  reach_to_rpath (reach_symm h)

lemma path_to_reach (edges : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (a b : Nat),
    p.head? = some a → p.getLast? = some b → path_follows_edges edges p → Reach edges a b := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro a b hh; simp at hh
  | cons z t ih =>
      intro a b hh hl hp
      obtain rfl : z = a := by simpa using hh
      cases t with
      | nil =>
          obtain rfl : a = b := by simpa using hl
          exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
      | cons y t' =>
          have hstep0 : Step edges a y := by
            have h0 := hp.2 0 (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
            simpa [getD_cons_zero', getD_one'] using h0
          rw [getLast?_cons_cons'] at hl
          have htail : path_follows_edges edges (y :: t') := path_tail hp (by simp)
          exact Relation.ReflTransGen.head hstep0 (ih y b (by first | rfl | simp) hl htail)

/-! ### Decidable connectivity via a reachability closure. -/

def adjB (edges : List MSTEdge) (S : Finset Nat) (v : Nat) : Bool :=
  edges.any (fun e => (decide (e.u ∈ S) && decide (e.v = v)) ||
                      (decide (e.v ∈ S) && decide (e.u = v)))

def stepSet (n : Nat) (edges : List MSTEdge) (S : Finset Nat) : Finset Nat :=
  S ∪ (Finset.range n).filter (fun v => adjB edges S v = true)

lemma mem_stepSet {n : Nat} {edges : List MSTEdge} {S : Finset Nat} {v : Nat} :
    v ∈ stepSet n edges S ↔ (v ∈ S ∨ (v < n ∧ adjB edges S v = true)) := by
  simp [stepSet, Finset.mem_union, Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_range]

/-- Vertices reachable from `0` in at most `k` steps. -/
def reachSet (n : Nat) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Nat → Finset Nat
  | 0 => {0}
  | k + 1 => stepSet n edges (reachSet n edges k)

lemma reachSet_subset_succ (n : Nat) (edges : List MSTEdge) (k : Nat) :
    reachSet n edges k ⊆ reachSet n edges (k + 1) := by
  intro v hv
  show v ∈ stepSet n edges (reachSet n edges k)
  exact mem_stepSet.mpr (Or.inl hv)

lemma reachSet_mono {n : Nat} {edges : List MSTEdge} {k m : Nat} (h : k ≤ m) :
    reachSet n edges k ⊆ reachSet n edges m := by
  induction m with
  | zero =>
      obtain rfl : k = 0 := by omega
      exact Finset.Subset.refl _
  | succ j ih =>
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (j + 1) with hk | hk
      · exact Finset.Subset.trans (ih (by omega)) (reachSet_subset_succ n edges j)
      · obtain rfl : k = j + 1 := by omega
        exact Finset.Subset.refl _

lemma reachSet_stable {n : Nat} {edges : List MSTEdge} {k : Nat}
    (h : reachSet n edges (k + 1) = reachSet n edges k) :
    ∀ m, reachSet n edges (k + m) = reachSet n edges k := by
  intro m
  induction m with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ j ih =>
      have he : k + (j + 1) = (k + j) + 1 := by omega
      rw [he]
      show stepSet n edges (reachSet n edges (k + j)) = reachSet n edges k
      rw [ih]
      exact h

lemma reachSet_card_ge (n : Nat) (edges : List MSTEdge) : ∀ j : Nat,
    (∀ i, i < j → reachSet n edges (i + 1) ≠ reachSet n edges i) →
    j + 1 ≤ (reachSet n edges j).card := by
  intro j
  induction j with
  | zero => intro _; simp [reachSet]
  | succ i ih =>
      intro hne
      have h1 : i + 1 ≤ (reachSet n edges i).card := ih (fun t ht => hne t (by omega))
      have hsub : reachSet n edges i ⊆ reachSet n edges (i + 1) := reachSet_subset_succ n edges i
      have hneq : reachSet n edges (i + 1) ≠ reachSet n edges i := hne i (by omega)
      have hlt : (reachSet n edges i).card < (reachSet n edges (i + 1)).card :=
        Finset.card_lt_card (Finset.ssubset_iff_subset_ne.mpr ⟨hsub, fun hh => hneq hh.symm⟩)
      omega

lemma reachSet_subset_range {n : Nat} {edges : List MSTEdge} (hn : 0 < n) :
    ∀ k, reachSet n edges k ⊆ Finset.range n := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro v hv
      have : v = 0 := by simpa [reachSet] using hv
      subst this
      simpa using hn
  | succ j ih =>
      intro v hv
      rcases mem_stepSet.mp hv with h | h
      · exact ih h
      · exact Finset.mem_range.mpr h.1

/-- The closure stabilises after at most `n` rounds. -/
lemma reachSet_le_n {n : Nat} {edges : List MSTEdge} (hn : 0 < n) (m : Nat) :
    reachSet n edges m ⊆ reachSet n edges n := by
  by_cases hstab : ∃ k, k < n ∧ reachSet n edges (k + 1) = reachSet n edges k
  · obtain ⟨k, hkn, hk⟩ := hstab
    have hst := reachSet_stable hk
    have hnk : reachSet n edges n = reachSet n edges k := by
      have h2 := hst (n - k)
      have h3 : k + (n - k) = n := by omega
      rw [h3] at h2
      exact h2
    have hmk : reachSet n edges m ⊆ reachSet n edges k := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge m k with hm | hm
      · exact reachSet_mono (by omega)
      · have h2 := hst (m - k)
        have h3 : k + (m - k) = m := by omega
        rw [h3] at h2
        rw [h2]
    rw [hnk]
    exact hmk
  · exfalso
    push_neg at hstab
    have h1 : n + 1 ≤ (reachSet n edges n).card :=
      reachSet_card_ge n edges n (fun i hi => hstab i hi)
    have h2 : (reachSet n edges n).card ≤ n := by
      have h3 := Finset.card_le_card (reachSet_subset_range (edges := edges) hn n)
      simpa using h3
    omega

lemma mem_reachSet_reach (n : Nat) (edges : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (k v : Nat),
    v ∈ reachSet n edges k → Reach edges 0 v := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro v hv
      have : v = 0 := by simpa [reachSet] using hv
      subst this
      exact Relation.ReflTransGen.refl
  | succ j ih =>
      intro v hv
      rcases mem_stepSet.mp hv with h | h
      · exact ih v h
      · obtain ⟨-, hadj⟩ := h
        simp only [adjB, List.any_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true,
          decide_eq_true_eq] at hadj
        obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := hadj
        rcases hc with ⟨hu, hv'⟩ | ⟨hv2, hu2⟩
        · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail (ih e.u hu) ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨rfl, hv'⟩⟩
        · exact Relation.ReflTransGen.tail (ih e.v hv2) ⟨e, he, Or.inr ⟨hu2, rfl⟩⟩

lemma reach_mem_reachSet {n : Nat} {edges : List MSTEdge}
    (hb : ∀ e ∈ edges, e.u < n ∧ e.v < n) {v : Nat} (h : Reach edges 0 v) :
    ∃ k, v ∈ reachSet n edges k := by
  induction h with
  | refl => exact ⟨0, by simp [reachSet]⟩
  | @tail b c _ hbc ih =>
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ih
      obtain ⟨e, he, hc⟩ := hbc
      have hbnd := hb e he
      rcases hc with ⟨h1, h2⟩ | ⟨h1, h2⟩
      · refine ⟨k + 1, mem_stepSet.mpr (Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)⟩
        · have := hbnd.2; omega
        · simp only [adjB, List.any_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true,
            decide_eq_true_eq]
          exact ⟨e, he, Or.inl ⟨by rw [h1]; exact hk, h2⟩⟩
      · refine ⟨k + 1, mem_stepSet.mpr (Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩)⟩
        · have := hbnd.1; omega
        · simp only [adjB, List.any_eq_true, Bool.or_eq_true, Bool.and_eq_true,
            decide_eq_true_eq]
          exact ⟨e, he, Or.inr ⟨by rw [h2]; exact hk, h1⟩⟩

def connCheck (n : Nat) (edges : List MSTEdge) : Bool :=
  decide (∀ v ∈ Finset.range n, v ∈ reachSet n edges n)

lemma connCheck_iff {n : Nat} {edges : List MSTEdge} :
    connCheck n edges = true ↔ ∀ v, v < n → v ∈ reachSet n edges n := by
  simp [connCheck, Finset.mem_range]

/-! ### Edge enumeration. -/

def allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) : List MSTEdge :=
  (List.range g.size).flatMap (fun u => (g.adj.getD u #[]).toList.map (fun p => ⟨u, p.1, p.2⟩))

lemma mem_allEdges (g : WeightedGraph) (e : MSTEdge) : e ∈ allEdges g ↔ e.is_valid g := by
  constructor
  · intro h
    simp only [allEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range] at h
    obtain ⟨u, hu, p, hp, he⟩ := h
    subst he
    exact ⟨hu, ⟨p, by first | simpa using hp | exact hp, rfl, rfl⟩⟩
  · intro h
    obtain ⟨hu, pair, hpair, h1, h2⟩ := h
    simp only [allEdges, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map, List.mem_range]
    refine ⟨e.u, hu, pair, ?_, ?_⟩
    · first | simpa using hpair | exact hpair
    · rw [h1, h2]

lemma valid_bounds (g : WeightedGraph) (hwf : g.well_formed) {e : MSTEdge}
    (h : e.is_valid g) : e.u < g.size ∧ e.v < g.size := by
  obtain ⟨hu, pair, hpair, h1, h2⟩ := h
  have := (hwf e.u hu).1 pair hpair
  omega

/-! ### Enumeration of candidate edge lists and minimum-weight selection. -/

def tuples (l : List MSTEdge) : Nat → List (List MSTEdge)
  | 0 => [[]]
  | k + 1 => l.flatMap (fun a => (tuples l k).map (fun t => a :: t))

lemma mem_tuples (l : List MSTEdge) : ∀ (k : Nat) (T : List MSTEdge),
    T ∈ tuples l k ↔ (T.length = k ∧ ∀ x ∈ T, x ∈ l) := by
  intro k
  induction k with
  | zero =>
      intro T
      constructor
      · intro h
        have : T = [] := by simpa [tuples] using h
        subst this; simp
      · rintro ⟨h1, -⟩
        have : T = [] := by simpa using h1
        subst this; simp [tuples]
  | succ j ih =>
      intro T
      constructor
      · intro h
        simp only [tuples, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map] at h
        obtain ⟨a, ha, t, ht, hT⟩ := h
        subst hT
        have hst := (ih t).mp ht
        refine ⟨by simp [hst.1], ?_⟩
        intro x hx
        rcases List.mem_cons.mp hx with h' | h'
        · subst h'; exact ha
        · exact hst.2 x h'
      · rintro ⟨h1, h2⟩
        cases T with
        | nil => simp at h1
        | cons a t =>
            simp only [tuples, List.mem_flatMap, List.mem_map]
            refine ⟨a, h2 a (by simp), t, ?_, rfl⟩
            exact (ih t).mpr ⟨by simpa using h1, fun x hx => h2 x (by simp [hx])⟩

def best : List (List MSTEdge) → Option (List MSTEdge)
  | [] => none
  | T :: rest =>
      match best rest with
      | none => some T
      | some B => if total_weight B < total_weight T then some B else some T

lemma best_isSome : ∀ (l : List (List MSTEdge)) (T : List MSTEdge), T ∈ l → ∃ B, best l = some B := by
  intro l
  cases l with
  | nil => intro T hT; simp at hT
  | cons T rest =>
      intro _ _
      cases hb : best rest with
      | none => exact ⟨T, by simp [best, hb]⟩
      | some C =>
          by_cases hc : total_weight C < total_weight T
          · exact ⟨C, by simp [best, hb, hc]⟩
          · exact ⟨T, by simp [best, hb, hc]⟩

lemma best_mem : ∀ (l : List (List MSTEdge)) (B : List MSTEdge), best l = some B → B ∈ l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro B h; simp [best] at h
  | cons T rest ih =>
      intro B h
      cases hb : best rest with
      | none =>
          simp only [best, hb] at h
          obtain rfl : T = B := by simpa using h
          simp
      | some C =>
          simp only [best, hb] at h
          by_cases hc : total_weight C < total_weight T
          · rw [if_pos hc] at h
            obtain rfl : C = B := by simpa using h
            exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (ih C hb)
          · rw [if_neg hc] at h
            obtain rfl : T = B := by simpa using h
            simp

lemma best_le : ∀ (l : List (List MSTEdge)) (B : List MSTEdge), best l = some B →
    ∀ T ∈ l, total_weight B ≤ total_weight T := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro B h; simp [best] at h
  | cons T rest ih =>
      intro B h X hX
      cases hb : best rest with
      | none =>
          simp only [best, hb] at h
          obtain rfl : T = B := by simpa using h
          rcases List.mem_cons.mp hX with h' | h'
          · subst h'; exact le_refl _
          · obtain ⟨C, hC⟩ := best_isSome rest X h'
            rw [hb] at hC; simp at hC
      | some C =>
          simp only [best, hb] at h
          by_cases hc : total_weight C < total_weight T
          · rw [if_pos hc] at h
            obtain rfl : C = B := by simpa using h
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hX with h' | h'
            · subst h'; omega
            · exact ih B hb X h'
          · rw [if_neg hc] at h
            obtain rfl : T = B := by simpa using h
            rcases List.mem_cons.mp hX with h' | h'
            · subst h'; exact le_refl _
            · have := ih C hb X h'
              omega

/-! ### Existence of a spanning tree (Prim-style tree growth). -/

lemma graph_path_tail {g : WeightedGraph} {z : Nat} {p : List Nat}
    (h : path_follows_graph g (z :: p)) (hp : 0 < p.length) : path_follows_graph g p := by
  refine ⟨hp, ?_⟩
  intro i hi
  have h2 := h.2 (i + 1) (by simp only [List.length_cons]; omega)
  simpa [getD_cons_succ'] using h2

/-- Any graph path leaving `S` must cross the cut. -/
lemma exists_cross (g : WeightedGraph) (S : Finset Nat) : ∀ (p : List Nat) (a b : Nat),
    p.head? = some a → p.getLast? = some b → path_follows_graph g p → a ∈ S → b ∉ S →
